entries.title: Technology Data for the Indonesian Power Sector 2024 (Danish Energy Agency and EA Energy Analyses), data sheet Batteries - Lithium-ion (utility-scale)
entries.quote: Batteries - Lithium-ion (utility-scale), column 2023: - energy component (MUSD/MWh) 0.35; - other project costs (MUSD/MWh) 0.04; uncertainty (2023) of the energy component 0.26 to 0.38
entries.unit_as_written: MUSD/MWh energy component, before 0.04 other project costs
entries.derivation: energy component 0.35 plus other project costs 0.04 MUSD/MWh in the 2023 column (the printed year nearest the study); 1 MUSD/MWh = 1000 USD/kWh; USD at price level 2022 without VAT, not escalated; the same page also has a Technology specific data block with a lower expansion cost (total 1.33 MUSD/MW, so 0.33 MUSD/MWh at 4 h) that does not add up with the financial block; the higher financial block is used

entries.quote: Batteries - Lithium-ion (utility-scale), column 2023: Fixed O&M (USD/MW/year) 15,000; Discharge time (hours) 4; Variable O&M (USD/MWh) 2.00
entries.derivation: fixed 15,000 USD per MW per year over the 4 h discharge time is 3.75 USD per kWh per year; variable O&M 2.00 USD/MWh at an upper bound of one full cycle a day adds 365 x 2.00 / 1000 = 0.73, so 4.48 in total (study f86df9819fa150a7 ran 249 cycles a year, computed)

entries.title: High cost of capital and limited project pipeline hinder clean energy investment in Southeast Asia (IEA commentary, Teng and Erdogan)
entries.quote: The median weighted average cost of capital (WACC, nominal, post-tax and in local currency) for solar PV in Indonesia, Viet Nam and the Philippines based on survey responses was 9.4%, 9.0% and 8.0% respectively in 2024
entries.derivation: real rate (1 + 0.094) / (1 + 0.025) - 1 = 0.0673, with the 2.5% inflation target for 2025 to 2027 set in PMK No. 31 of 2024 (Bank Indonesia inflation page); the higher of two sourced real rates (IRENA, The cost of financing for renewable power, 2023, Appendix Figure A1: 6.0% real after tax for solar PV in Indonesia in 2021); a solar PV rate used for the whole system, and the IEA says batteries cost more to finance, so see the sensitivity row at 1.2 times (0.081)

entries.title: Harga Solar Industri 01-14 Maret 2026 (Solar Industri, a fuel reseller, reposting the Pertamina Patra Niaga industrial fuel list)
entries.quote: Harga Dasar (Rp/Liter) Harga Dasar (US$/Liter) Biosolar Industri (B40) (Wilayah 1) IDR 21.250 USD 1,26
entries.derivation: median of the list's own USD/L column for wilayah 1 (Java) over the 17 half-month lists from October 2025 to September 2026 that pass the period check (the quote is one of them; range 1.03 to 1.64 USD/L; median 21,250 IDR/L), so no exchange rate is assumed; loco depot price before PPN, PPh, PBBKB and sea transport, so a floor for the island; one list value (23,050 IDR/L) matches a Pertamina Patra Niaga letter reported by Kontan (Rp 23,05 juta per KL tanpa pajak)
